TASK T73 · W5 · Corpus index in reports and a totals row on /r
GOAL: The public-repo reviews already on disk (reports/<owner>__<repo>/review.json) become one corpus index with totals that add up, and
the /r page shows a totals row from it. The corpus runner (scripts/corpus-run.ts) and table builder (src/review/corpus-table.ts) are merged.
READ: scripts/corpus-run.ts (runCorpus), src/review/corpus-table.ts (buildCorpusTable), web/app/r/page.tsx, web/lib/reviews.ts,
scripts/sumcheck.ts, scripts/facts.ts (CORPUS_* facts).
OWNS: scripts/corpus-index.ts (new), web/app/r/page.tsx (totals row only), web/lib/reviews.ts (only to read reports/corpus/index.json),
tests/corpus-index.test.ts
BUILD: `bun scripts/corpus-index.ts` reads every reports/<owner>__<repo>/review.json except rajkaria__roster and _sample, maps each to
buildCorpusTable's row shape (repo, sessions, setups, costUsd, suspect, replayed 0, promoted null), and writes reports/corpus/index.json
({schemaVersion: 1, generatedAt, data: {rows, totals}}). /r shows a totals row (repos, sessions, spend). scripts/sumcheck.ts must pass on
the output (add nothing to sumcheck; if it doesn't already cover the file, say so).
ACCEPTANCE: tests on a fixture reports dir: index built, totals equal row sums, our own repo and _sample excluded; `cd web && bun run
build` succeeds.
TEST: bun test tests/corpus-index.test.ts && (cd web && bun run build) && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.

content.text:
T73 is built and committed as `78d59dc`. `bun scripts/corpus-index.ts` now writes `reports/corpus/index.json`, and `/r` shows a totals line from it.

- **Index:** it covers 6 repos and 218 sessions. It reads each `reports/<owner>__<repo>/review.json`, skips `rajkaria__roster` and `_sample`, and uses `buildCorpusTable` for the rows and totals, so the totals equal the row sums. I committed the generated `index.json` along with the script.
- **Row fields:** `costUsd` is the sum of the setups' priced `spend_usd`. It is null if no setup is priced, and it is a lower bound when some sessions are unpriced. `replayed` is 0 and `promoted` is null.
- **`/r` page:** the totals line shows repos, sessions and spend. The spend is labelled "priced sessions only", and the line is hidden if the index is missing or malformed. I added `loadCorpusTotals()` to `web/lib/reviews.ts` and did not touch `listReviews`.
- **Tests:** I wrote `tests/corpus-index.test.ts` first and saw it fail before implementing. It passes (4 tests), covering the built index, totals equal to row sums, exclusions, and a re-run ignoring the old index. The full suite shows 851 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail. `bun run typecheck` is clean, and `cd web && bun run build` succeeds.
- **sumcheck:** `bun scripts/sumcheck.ts` passes on the output (27 files). It does not really cover this file, because its rules look for `total`+`by_setup` and similar fields, and the index uses `totals`. I added nothing to it, as instructed.

`src/types.ts` is unchanged.

`web/` had no `node_modules`, so I ran `bun install` there (gitignored). Running the web build also copies `reports/` into `web/public/data`, which is how `/r` gets its review rows. That directory does not appear in `git status`, so it looks gitignored.

Nothing is left unfinished.
